name: Zheli Meiyou GreenDam
source:
Simply wanted to find a job, but turned out to cause so much trouble. Then I received a mysterious test item... a young girl?! Am I gonna start living happily ever after? or just the prelude of a disaster! My story with her has just begun... Hope this game can make you feel a little touched.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109460/]Steam[/url]]
